# `prog`

Helper: `prog(pct, { label, tone })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

Track (8px, tile) and fill, optional label above.

## Variants

- Tone: brand (default), success, warning, danger, info

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile, brand-500, success, warning, danger, info, ink-soft

## Do

- Show the percent or fraction in words next to it

## Don't

- Do not use it as a skin-improvement score

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Fills the row.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.
